summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyze Soony's confidential launch data, find where the plan hides problems, and build a general agent product (poller, extraction, recompute, act) with a calm mobile-first Today decision flow, routines and voice, ready for a 12:00 Sunday hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found the hidden launch risks (art book overbooking, failed statue lot, game card shortfall, sleeve revision conflict) and a new 14:37 drop, produced briefing docs and an interview doc, then built and pushed the calm Today app on branch jonas/today-flow with email review, routines diagrams, a verifier fix (game cards 34,800 to 6,800) and a voice two-step flow. Plan/Today redundancy, the blinking suppliers map and the hand-in material remain open.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/; .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed; never commit values or put data values in code.
Portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path}, /archive.zip with no webhooks; changes must be detected by polling and comparing SHA-256, and existing files are replaced under the same name.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist; tasks are claimed in PROGRESS.md and pushes require Entire enabled and Brain connected.
Entire skips checkpoints when no repo files changed in a turn; it only checkpoints at commits with session changes and pushes checkpoints with git push.

Verifier counts inbound only when supplier documents confirm them; the image recognizer's reading put part numbers in the 'item' field rather than 'material_id', requiring a fallback in the doc-line mapping.
New routines default to 'ask' mode; legacy code-only routines have no recipe so cannot render a diagram and were backed up to data/state/routines.before-legacy-cleanup-*.json.
Voice decisions now use a prepare then decide two-step with a one-time token; show_on_screen is answered in the browser, not relayed.

Test suite is run with uv run pytest (220 passing) and ruff; frontend checked via tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json and npm run build; a .vite/ cache folder appears in repo root and is excluded from commits.

code.finding: Wide routine view restructured into When/Then/Always lanes that wrap; narrow vertical layout kept for panel and phone.
Each part now has 'arriving' and 'not_counted' lists; gap = needed - usable - arriving; unread shipping documents make inbound not counted (conservative).
Focus view hosts the email review dialog; sent emails have no Undo, internal steps keep Undo.

workflow: Subagents/parallel builders work well when each owns distinct files; one builder owns the whole front end to avoid edit conflicts.
Ask before paid API calls (the user's rule); a single OpenAI recognizer call on one PDF was approved explicitly.
Verify UI changes with Playwright screenshots on mocked state, and on live data by viewing only without clicking, to avoid real supplier emails.
Keep confidential data out of external services and out of git; share artifacts only with the team.

friction: API token was initially empty, blocking data access until supplied.
Dashboard still showed 34,800 game cards until a paid recognizer reading existed locally.
Undo button was shown after an email was sent, which is misleading since emails can't be recalled.
Voice assistant said it would outline the decision and then just reported 'done', requiring a two-step token fix.
Legacy code-only routines showed no diagram and one failed with old building blocks.
Flow/Steps/Expanded views for routines were redundant; Today and Plan decision panes duplicate each other.
Portal login password was pasted in Discord history; the transcript noted it may need changing.
Unknown whether portal data and supplier replies differ per team.
open_items: Push latest commits to jonas/today-flow and decide on PR #5 (jonas/alert-platform into main) versus a new PR.
Make Plan a pure overview that opens Today for decisions, and offer automation after the second similar decision.
Explain/fix the blinking animations on the Suppliers map (investigation in progress).
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings and send the Karton Nowak art book order and Boise reply through the product.

Plan view still dense; Standard shows 32,000 at risk from the uncollected 350,000 card cases at the port (maybe amber 'fixable by collecting').
Hand-in by 12:00: README section, demo script, 3-minute video, deck.
Delete data/state.json snapshot after the hack; earlier Claude doc may be removed; briefing page and doc still show the 14:00 state.
